

Call `mdblocks.Normalize` on the body in each store write path
`markdownWriters` lists for `Doc.Body`, `Rule.Body` and `Task.Body`:
`CreateDoc`, `UpdateDocBody`, `PatchDoc` (`internal/store/docs.go`,
`docpatch.go`), `AddRule`, `EditRule` (`rulestandalone.go`, `rules.go`),
`CreateTask`, `UpdateTaskFields` (`tasks.go`). Normalisation runs before
inline-reference extraction so `inline_refs` sees the stored text. A write
whose normalised body equals the stored body is still a no-op where it was
one before (`EditRule`'s "same text, no new version" check compares
normalised against stored).

Rule and document edits that land through `lode doc edit` on an accepted
spec write rules; the accepted version row is untouched, the draft row is
what gets normalised. Add a store test per writer.

```go
func TestEditRuleNormalises(t *testing.T) {
    s := newTestStore(t)
    r := mustAddRule(t, s, "Heading", "para one\nwrapped here\n\n* star bullet\n")
    got, _ := s.EditRule(ctx, "WL", r.Number, model.EditRuleInput{Heading: "Heading", Body: "para one\nwrapped here\n\n* star bullet\n"}, "stig")
    if string(got.Body) != "para one wrapped here\n\n- star bullet\n" {
        t.Fatalf("body not normalised: %q", got.Body)
    }
}
```
